privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Ki Banawat
privacyPolicy.subtitle: Transparent, local-first aur ekdam secure.
privacyPolicy.manifestoTitle: Manifesto: Aapka data hamara product NAHI hai.
privacyPolicy.manifestoText: YT Deluxe ko invisible banne ke liye engineer kiya gaya hai.
privacyPolicy.q1Title: Hum kaun sa data jama karte hain?
privacyPolicy.q1Text: Hum sirf wahi data jama karte hain jo zaruri hai: YouTube URLs, quality preferences aur download history (agar aap chahein).
privacyPolicy.q2Title: Hum ise kyun jama karte hain?
privacyPolicy.q2Text: Sirf aapke downloads manage karne ke liye.
privacyPolicy.q3Text: Aapka data aapke paas hi rehta hai. Browser mein localStorage aur Windows par local JSON file.
privacyPolicy.firstPrinciple: Hum Sovereignty First rules par kaam karte hain. Meta-data aur storage aapka hai.
privacyPolicy.zeroExfiltration: Zero-Exfiltration: Browser history sirf localStorage mein rehti hai.
privacyPolicy.localFiles: Local Files: Windows users ko poori visibility milti hai.
privacyPolicy.noAnalytics: No Analytics: Humein aapka focus pyara hai; koi tracking pixels nahi.
privacyPolicy.ephemeral: Hamara engine strict temporary cycle follow karta hai.

aboutUs.heroSubtitle: ★ Hinglish Mode Active ★ - Sabse Premium Media Downloader
aboutUs.visionText1: YT Deluxe ek simple zarurat se paida hua tha: aaj ke digital world ko ek pakka, ad-free aur uncompromising tool manage karne ki zarurat hai. Jab content itna temporary ho gaya hai, toh ek saaf aur high-quality archive rakhna koi luxury nahi, balki ek necessity hai.
aboutUs.visionText2: React aur FastAPI ke full-stack combo par bana ye platform, world-class yt-dlp core ko ek smooth 'Liquid Glass' interface ke sath jodta hai. Hamara mission hai learners aur creators ko ek ad-free, secure aur features se bharpoor experience dena.
aboutUs.feat1Desc: 144p se lekar 8K tak, sab bdiya quality milegi.
aboutUs.feat2Desc: Koi tracking nahi, sab safe hai.
aboutUs.feat3Desc: Utna hi kaato jitna zarurat ho bina quality kharaye.
aboutUs.feat4Desc: Web app ya Windows dono par mast chalega.
aboutUs.devRole: Full Stack Artisan aur System Engineer
aboutUs.devDesc: High-performance aur dikhne mein lajawab systems banane ka junoon. YT Deluxe technical robustness aur premium 'Liquid Glass' design ka ek perfect fusion hai, jiska focus user experience, scalability aur security par hai.
aboutUs.footerBanner: Sirf Seekhne Ke Liye • Open Source
aboutUs.footerText: © 2026 YT Deluxe. Utsav Parmar ne banaya. React aur yt-dlp ke sath.
